summary.headline: Brothers’ Reputation and Nobility
summary.text: Chapter 14 discusses the reputation, nobility, prosperity, and family standing of brothers, using the three lords of the triplicity of the house of brothers to signify older, middle, and younger brothers. Planetary separations and applications involving the Moon, fortunes, infortunes, exaltation, own houses, cadent planets, and descent determine sibling order, happiness, death, ruin, and association with nobles and princes.
